title: Package Management Systems
content:
Requirements:

The selected package manager need support for:

  • npm Registry
  • Maven artifacts
  • Docker images

Integration with major CI/CD pipelines, e.g Azure Devops, Atlassian Pipelines.

Options:

The following tools have been identified as valid options:

JFrog Artifactory: https://jfrog.com/artifactory/

GitHub Package Registry: https://github.com/features/package-registry

Azure DevOps Artifacts https://azure.microsoft.com/sv-se/services/devops/artifacts/

Primary choice:

JFrog or Azure Artifcats are the primary choices. Drawback with Azure Artifacts is that it doesn't handle Docker Images, we then must use either AWS ECR or Azure Container Registry.
